```{r setup}
library(lrmodel)
```


In the vignette(s), include comparison(s) against the original R functions on 
simulated or real datasets to demonstrate both the correctness (e.g., via 
all.equal()) and the efficiency (e.g., via bench::mark()) of the implemented 
functions. Your implementation is not required to outperform the original 
functions.

```{r}
all.equal(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$coefficients, 
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$coefficients
)

all.equal(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$residuals,
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$residuals
)

all.equal(
  lrmodel(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$fitted.values,
  lm(mpg ~ wt, mtcars)$fitted.values
)
```
